title: post users logup user registration
description: Test user registration with valid data to receive 201 status and user created confirmation. Also test registration with missing or invalid fields to verify validation error responses.

title: post users loginin user login
description: Test user login with valid credentials to receive 201 status with token and user data. Also test login with invalid credentials to verify authentication failure response.

title: post attendance checkin employee checkin
description: Test employee check-in with valid JWT and shift context to receive 201 status confirming check-in registered. Also test check-in without authentication token to receive unauthorized error.

title: post attendance checkout employee checkout
description: Test employee check-out with valid JWT to receive 201 status confirming check-out registered. Also test check-out with expired or invalid token to receive unauthorized or forbidden error.

title: get attendance shift get shift data
description: Test retrieval of employee shift data with valid JWT to receive 200 status and shift data. Also test access without authentication token to receive unauthorized error.

title: post managing auto checkout automatic checkout
description: Test automatic checkout process with valid manager JWT to receive 201 status confirming auto check completed. Also test with invalid token to receive unauthorized error.

title: get managing pending excuses list excuses
description: Test retrieval of pending excuses list with valid manager JWT to receive 200 status and list of excuses. Also test access without manager authorization to receive forbidden error.

title: post managing approve excuse approve excuse
description: Test approval of a pending excuse by ID with valid manager JWT to receive 201 status confirming excuse approved. Also test approval with nonexistent excuse ID to receive not found error.
